notes.title: ATOMINE 2.1.1 Improving controller support and Bug fixing
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After a long time we are back to work a little on ATOMINE.

In this update we fixed some problems with the controller support and other minor Bugs. If you have had any controller issues in the past, please try again and let us know if you have any further problems!

Thank you for your patience.


And remember to have a look of our new game : Hundred Days Winemaking Simulator


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042380/Hundred_Days__Winemaking_Simulator/

notes.title: Hundred Days - Our new Wine Making Game
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16585301/972dea3cda7f567e00d9b2d6a1ea6c2ce66610bf.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce [b]Hundred Days[/b], our new wine making game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042380/Hundred_Days/


In Hundred Days you will have complete control of a new winery, you will have to choose which vines to grow and how to grow them and when to harvest, you will have to follow the entire winemaking process and make the choices that best suit the type of wine you want to produce or that market requires. You will also have to sell the wine produced to allow your company to expand.

As in reality, every choice made, from the vineyard to the sales, will be able to influence the wine produced both quantitatively and qualitatively. A quality wine will increase the reputation of your company worldwide, it may have come at a higher price and will allow you to grow better and faster.

Please [b]Wishlist[/b] it if you like the game and you want to support us.

Thank you

notes.title: ATOMINE 2.0.0 IS HERE! (finally)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28610580/cf515a9676a4285d153478b2a7e4138a296a3d23.jpg[/img]

So after a very long summer, we are finally able to release the new version of ATOMINE.

I think that this time chang log is not capable of describing what's new in v 2.0.0.

We build up from the ground of the Enemy, now they have different behaviors, decent pathfinding and will not shoot anymore through walls, or when you are not in sight.
The game change drastically, so for the player that have mastered the older version will find a complete new challenge now.
We also fixed a lot of annoying bugs and little glitches, this is by far the most stable and fun version of the game!

Once again, thank you so much for the fantastic support and if you like the game please help us with a review:D

To all Hackers!

A really important update, we fixed a lot of bugs thanks to yours reports :D

In Short:

- Reduced number of rooms in Core;
- Enemy Mine, fixed
- Shadow addon fix
- No Enemy will spawn outside the world
- Enemy spawned in the Boss arena will now attack
- Player can not go out of bound in the last level
- Secret Teleport works again
- wrong enemy dead animation fix
- XP will fly less frequently out of bound
- Enemy will not spawn in the entry room
- Special Aena room fix
- A LOT of minor bug fix

Thank you so much for the support, and as always if you like the game support us with a  REVIEW, would help a lot

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 FULL POWER UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28610580/d65f3b0698fbb3065d4846353885e3882ecfa539.gif[/img]

We decided that before we move on to the production of new content we fix one of the biggest issues... PERFORMANCE ːAtominegː

We finally put all our effort in optimization, we have increased the framerate by 50-75 % 

IF YOU STILL EXPERIENCE LAGGY INPUT AND POOR FRAMERATE, PLEASE CHECK IF VSYNC IS ENABLED ( IF YES DISABLE IT ːsteamhappyː )

We also started to tackle our next big problem, AI, not perfect yet but we started to do some optimization like:
- Enemies don't shoot at you if you are not in sight
- Enemies can move between rooms

We know that this fix is not enough but please keep patience until next update :)

Some other problem we started to fix:
- Energy, a lot of you is not happy about the randomness of the energy drop, we discovered that a really useful update is available for the player only late in the game, so we decided to implement two new upgrades, that cure the player in early gameplay.
- Sound Design, a first fix for the laser SFX and Electricity, hope you like this better 
- Minor bug fix
- No energy drop fix

Thank you so much for the support and patience, and please if you like the game support us with a ːAtomineEː REVIEW ːAtomineEː, would help a lot ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update v 1.1.2
notes.content:
First of all, I wanna thank you for the support and love you shared with us.
We are working hard to polish and fix the experience! So here is the first update!

Change log v 1.1.2
- CRITICAL BUG FIX, framerate loss over time.
- Keyboard/Mouse end game bug! 
- The Glitch effect can be deactivated in the settings
- Russian and Italian Localisation
- Language can be chosen in the Settings menu
- Settings menu are more navigable with the Joystick
- A LOT of minor bug fix 

Keep on hacking!!
